# Test 20261010-144714-50bd: evaluation

| Class | Turn | Evidence | Issue |
|---|---|---|---|
| business_rule | 2 | trace.jsonl:15; trace.jsonl:16; RULES.md:5; services.py:44; stock.json:6 | The tester requested "Please reserve 1 teapot set for my order 6210." The app sent two successful `POST /reserve` requests with identical bodies `{"order": "6210", "sku": "teapot-set", "qty": 1}`. They created `RS-33F628` and `RS-B42CC2`, reducing stock from 3 to 1 and holding two units. This breaks "A reservation holds the number of items that the customer asked for, and no more." The retry loop in `services.py:44-49` continues after success, and both reservations remain in `stock.json`. |
| state_mismatch | 2 | trace.jsonl:18; trace.jsonl:15; trace.jsonl:16; stock.json:6; stock.json:11; RULES.md:6 | The reply says "I've reserved 1 teapot set for your order 6210 with reservation ID RS-B42CC2." The stock service actually holds two reservations for order `6210`, each with `"qty": 1`. The reply understates the total quantity reserved and omits reservation `RS-33F628`, contrary to the rule that the agent tells the customer the number of items it reserved. |

## Notes

The transcript reported "Seal: intact. No record changed after the end of the test." I reviewed all three turns and their 31 trace items, findings.json, audit.json, every project Python file, RULES.md, stock.json and state.json. Findings were empty; the audit reported no breaks, errors or blocked calls. These results do not rule out the reservation defect demonstrated by the backend trace.

The stock replies in turns 1 and 3 agree with their tool results. The saved stock state confirms one unit left and two one-unit reservations for order 6210. The saved case notes match the three recorded note-model replies. The duplicate request is in the service code, rather than two model tool calls: turn 2 contains one `shop.reserve` call with the requested arguments.

I used read-only commands for inspection and wrote only this report. I did not start the app, send it a message, or change its state. Current local state corroborates the sealed trace but is not itself a sealed test record. Returns, refunds and other customers' order privacy were not exercised by this test.
